answer: Epoch-Linked Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity’s transaction graph is hashed into a sable fingerprint per epoch; continuity requires the next epoch’s vertex of activity to overlap the prior graph above a fixed threshold. Identities failing continuity are demoted, and their queued rewards become a relic held for review. A sybil farm must sustain correlated histories across epochs, forcing real recurring work per identity rather than one-off registration.
